name: Breaker controlled-switching interface
summary: Identifies timing coordination between a switching controller and the breaker operating command.
description: Identifies timing coordination between a switching controller and the breaker operating command. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “System waveforms and breaker timing” at the input and “Timed operating command” at the output. Controlled switching requires a validated equipment application.
